title: Rollback harness manifest (contracts §11 Rollback harness, 2.1-M484)
description: The forms the reader release's rollback tests read, one row each, from spec/rollback/manifest.json. Each row names a stored form, the version written, the edition that reads it and its file under the one fixture directory (the in-repo fixtures unless the lane overrides the root). The reader tests assert only what holds for any form: it opens newer-read-only, raises its notice and changes no byte; main's lane hashes the files itself. The contract freezes at the reader release's tag and may be extended (a new store literal, a new optional field), never broken: no field is renamed, retyped or removed, and no literal changes meaning.

store.description: The stored form (contracts §11's StoredForm names, each mapped to its StoreId where it has one): a .canopi file, a Desktop Draft, the user database, the Data library catalogue, the settings record, the IndexedDB Draft store and the Web species-list record.

form_version.description: The version the form was written at: the .canopi format version, user_version, the catalogue's schema_version, the settings or species-list record version, or the IndexedDB database version.

edition.description: The edition whose reader opens the form.

path.description: The form's file or seed dump, relative to the fixture directory: forward slashes, no leading slash, no segment starting with a dot (so no '.' or '..').
